$comment: Vidak ontology proposal v1 (Video). schemaId is intentionally omitted — MetaState must assign a stable W3ID and publish this schema before W3DS_ONTOLOGY_ADAPTER_ENABLED may be turned on. Do not invent schema IDs.
title: Video
description: Interoperable video metadata for Vidak as a W3DS Post-Platform. Media bytes are addressed by an optional w3ds://file URI (not a local storage key or unsigned HTTP URL).

id.description: MetaEnvelope object id within the owner eVault (local W3ID / UUID). Distinct from Vidak's product-local video id.

ownerEName.description: Owner eName of the eVault that stores this MetaEnvelope. Mapping Rules ownerEnamePath resolves to this identity.

channelId.description: Reference to the Channel MetaEnvelope object id (global layer), not a product-local channel primary key.

visibility.description: Discovery/access intent. Future ACL mapping: public→["*"], private→owner eName, unlisted→deliberate ACL.

mediaFileUri.description: Interoperable media reference. Future adapter mapping uses __file(...) → w3ds://file?id=@<ename>/<meta-envelope-id>. Never a filesystem path or bare storage key.

thumbnailFileUri.description: Optional thumbnail as a w3ds://file URI (same contract as mediaFileUri).

publicVideoId.description: Stable public discovery key assigned on first publish; may persist across unpublish.
